原名: 特别篇 รับ (รัก) ออกแบบ ตอนพิเศษ
导演: 吉迪萨克·奇瓦沙加萨昆
主演: 素帕莎拉提·阿卡拉塔威帕

简介: A feng shui master's prediction about their relationship causes tension between Aokbab and Rin as they disagree over what is most important to them. Tertis and Vee's relationship becomes complicated when they start to work for rival companies — and a meddling ex makes the situation worse.
